evidence.section: At a glance: Stargardt Disease / What is Stargardt disease? / What are the symptoms of Stargardt disease? / What causes Stargardt disease?
evidence.scope: 美国 NEI 面向公众的Stargardt病健康教育
evidence.text: Stargardt 病常出现渐进性中心视力下降，也可伴畏光，症状可能在儿童或青少年时期开始。

evidence.section: How will my eye doctor check for Stargardt disease?
evidence.scope: 美国 NEI 面向公众的Stargardt病健康教育
evidence.text: 散瞳检查和眼底照相可寻找黄斑黄色斑点。医生还可结合视网膜电图和基因检测评估 Stargardt 病。

evidence.section: What's the treatment for Stargardt disease?
evidence.scope: 美国 NEI 面向公众的Stargardt病健康教育
evidence.text: Stargardt 病患者可通过助视设备和康复适应中心视力损失。NEI 提醒避免补充超过每日推荐量的维生素 A。
